question: 今月の受注金額上位5件を表示してください
response: SELECT ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM APP.ORDERS WHERE ORDER_DATE >= DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
